response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience with C++ and embedded systems (e.g., National Instruments) but lacks recent, direct C++ development for industrial automation or cloud platforms. Their expertise leans heavily toward modern web and mobile technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and D language, which doesn't align closely with the role's focus on C++ and industrial cybersecurity. However, their deep systems programming background and architectural contributions are notable.
strengths: Proven track record in high-performance, low-latency applications
Demonstrated expertise in secure coding practices (TDD, CI/CD, dev-ops)
concerns: Limited recent C++ work (last C++ role in 2015, now focused on TypeScript/D)
No direct experience with industrial automation protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
No apparent exposure to IEC 62443 or industrial cybersecurity standards
